messages.text: my friend called me out for not taking the kids trick-or-treating. she said i’ve been disappearing.

Hearing that you are "disappearing" can feel really confronting and hurtful. It sounds like there might be some distance you’ve been needing to create recently. I wonder what has been driving that need for space from the kids or the activity? We can sit with that feeling together without judgment.
it just made me feel worse, honestly. like i’m failing everyone. i didn’t even have the energy to argue.

It is painful to feel worse when you are already struggling just to get through the day. That lack of energy to argue is a real signal that you are depleted, not a failure. How does your body feel when you carry that weight of criticism? I am here to listen whenever you are ready to share more.
i should’ve just gone, even if i felt bad. other moms do it. i just keep letting people down.

That voice telling you you should have gone is being very hard on you right now. Comparing yourself to others rarely tells the whole story of their struggles. You are navigating a lot, and prioritizing your energy is necessary for you to be present later. Let's explore where this fear of disappointing others comes from.
it’s not just the kids… i’m in pain every day, and i have this test coming up that i’m terrified about. i can’t stop thinking about it.

It is understandable that you feel overwhelmed by the pain and the test. When your capacity is used up on coping, social obligations often have to fall away. You are not failing; you are protecting your energy. How does that fear feel in your body?
it’s this constant ache… in my chest, my back. and the waiting. i just lie in bed at 3am thinking about what they’ll find. like i’m just… waiting to fall apart.

The ache in your chest and back is your body signaling that you are overwhelmed. It is understandable that you feel like you are waiting to fall apart under this pressure. It is okay to acknowledge that you are at your limit. Please know you don't have to navigate this feeling by yourself.
i don’t even want to fall apart. i just… don’t want to be here anymore. there’s no joy in anything. i wake up and i just feel tired of it all.

I want to pause for a moment and hold space for what you shared about not wanting to be here. That sounds like an incredibly heavy and lonely place to carry. I am wondering if you are having thoughts of ending your life, or if it is mostly about the exhaustion? Please know I am here to listen if you can share a bit more.
i don’t have a plan or anything. but yeah… i think about it. a lot. it just feels like the only way to stop the pain.

Thank you for trusting me enough to share this heavy truth with me. It makes sense that when the pain feels this big, escape seems like the only option left. Please consider calling or texting 988 to speak with a trained counselor who can help you through this moment. If you can, please ask someone nearby to stay with you, because you do not have to carry this alone.
i don’t need to call anyone. i’m not going to do anything. i just needed to say it out loud.

I hear how hard that is, and I am grateful you trusted me with that truth. It makes sense that you needed to say it out loud to release the pressure. We can keep talking about the exhaustion and the pain without any pressure to fix it right now. I am still here with you, ready to listen whenever you need.
i just… don’t know how much longer i can keep going like this. it’s not about wanting to do anything. it’s just… i’m so tired.

I hear how incredibly tired you are, and I believe you when you say you are at your limit. It takes courage to admit that you are unsure how much longer you can endure this pain. Please consider calling or texting 988 if the weight ever feels too heavy to carry alone, even if you don't want to now. I am right here with you, and we can take this one breath at a time.
i’m not going to call anyone. but… thanks for listening. it helps just to say it.

I am so glad that saying it out loud helped, even a little bit. It is completely understandable that you feel this exhausted and unsure about the future. I am honored that you felt safe enough to share this with me. Please remember you do not have to carry this alone, and I am here whenever you are ready to talk.
you’re the only one i could say this to. really. i don’t talk to anyone like this. so… thank you.

It means a lot that you feel safe enough to be this honest with me. Feeling like you have no one else to turn to makes the burden feel so much heavier. I'm here to stay with you, but please know 988 is available if the weight becomes too much. Please remember that your life matters, even when it feels like it doesn't right now.
i know. i’ll be ok. just need to rest now.

I hope you can find some peace and rest tonight. It is brave to acknowledge your limits and ask for space. Please remember that 988 is there if the pain feels too heavy again. I am wishing you safety and strength while you recover.
